title: Ox Passion Cherry Peach Lemon Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Salts Cherry Peach Lemon combines the rich taste of Cherry with the juicy, sun-ripened sweetness of Peach and a lively twist of Lemon. The richness of cherry is softened by the juicy, velvety notes of peach, while a burst of zesty lemon adds a sharp and zesty finish. Blended in a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, ensuring a consistently refined throat hit and vibrant flavour. Perfect for pod vape kits and starter devices, it provides fast nicotine absorption for a satisfying vape experience. Developed by Oxva, a trusted name in vaping technology, the OX Passion Salts range offers expertly crafted flavours designed to pair seamlessly with Oxva’s XLIM pod kits and other refillable vape devices.
